description: The plot illustrates training loss trajectories over optimization iterations for multiple model variants, with several colored lines overlaid and a legend listing “Vanilla,” “StrmLLM (n=64),” “SepLLM (n=64),” “SepLLM (n=64, H),” “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” and “SepLLM (n=128).” The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” appears linear, and spans from 0 to about 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 20,000-iteration intervals (e.g., 20,000, 40,000, …, 140,000). The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” appears linear, and ranges approximately from 2.4 up to 3.4 with tick labels spaced by 0.1. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a faint shaded band around it (indicating variability), and no distinct point markers are visible. All lines start near the top of the axis around loss ≈3.4 at iteration 0, drop steeply within the early iterations to a minimum around the 10,000–20,000 iteration region (roughly between ≈2.65 and ≈2.9 depending on the series), and then gradually rise over the remainder of training; by the right edge near 140,000 iterations, the highest curve is the light blue line (StrmLLM (n=64)) ending just under ≈3.0, while the other curves (purple/orange/green/red/dark blue corresponding to the remaining legend entries) end clustered lower, around roughly ≈2.8–≈2.9, after a slow upward drift from their minima.
